life-support.title: Life Support

mare-s-nest.title: Mare's Nest
mare-s-nest.overview: Moon travels through a mysterious unexplained world free of adults. Moon meets a scholar turned sage and her translator in a mountain hut, where she tries to understand what is happening, based on a play by Don DeLillo. She meets many others who perform for her, show her a film, give her gifts, show her different possibilities for living. She observes and moves on into an unknown future.
mare-s-nest.cast: Moon Guo Barker, Astrid Ihora, Elahni-ja'nai Nembhard, Iris Andueza Reig, Saioia Andueza Reig, Sofia Hurtado Lichel

ice-cream-man.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

handa-opera-on-sydney-harbour-puccini-s-.overview: At an anniversary party, Sohrab Handa is found dead, with his throat slit in the hall. As the investigation unravels, friendships are tested, and secrets are revealed.
handa-opera-on-sydney-harbour-puccini-s-.cast: Vinay Pathak, Koel Purie, Neil Bhoopalam, Palomi Ghosh, Sharat Katariya, Sadiya Siddiqui

dance-fitness.title: Dance Fitness for Beginners - Urban Street Heat
dance-fitness.overview: Who knew getting a full-body cardio workout could be so much fun!  Urban Street Heat is more like a dance party than an aerobics class.  MaDonna Grimes makes working out fun in this fresh and funky Dance Fitness for Beginners program.

the-makings-of-a-murderer-the-undercover.title: Selfless: The Makings of a Champion
the-makings-of-a-murderer-the-undercover.overview: Get to know a little more about the Hunter Lawrence story with this short film titled Selfless: The Makings of a Champion. With insights from father Darren Lawrence, brother Jett, and of course Hunter Lawrence himself, it’s a unique look into the mindset and moral compass of an athlete who has both enjoyed and endured one of the most impressive journeys to the top of our sport.
the-makings-of-a-murderer-the-undercover.cast: Hunter Lawrence, Jett Lawrence, Darren Lawrence

phantoms-of-the-popera-starring-g4.title: Phantoms of the PopEra
phantoms-of-the-popera-starring-g4.overview: Revisit the first music videos of Beat Crusaders' major-era from 2004-2005.
phantoms-of-the-popera-starring-g4.cast: Cim, Toru Hidaka, Takayuki Araki, Taro Kato, Masahiko Kubota, Keita Tanabe

fred-dinenage-s-ronnie-reggie-me.title: Fred
fred-dinenage-s-ronnie-reggie-me.overview: Fred (Vincent Lindon) is a former crane driver who was a victim of the closure of his factory. He takes care of the little boy of his girlfriend (Clotilde Courau), does the housework and sometimes goes to the job center but boredom is inescapable. One day, because he accepted to drive a truck for a friend to a warehouse, he's caught up in a vicious spiral that goes beyond him. It's all the more serious as shady men want to eliminate him an the police is on his back.
fred-dinenage-s-ronnie-reggie-me.cast: Vincent Lindon, Clotilde Courau, François Berléand, Stéphane Jobert, Roschdy Zem, Albert Dray

some-like-it-hot-1959-at-the-ritz.title: Some Like It Hot
some-like-it-hot-1959-at-the-ritz.overview: In Prohibition-era Chicago, musicians Joe and Jerry witness a mob hit, and flee the state in an all-female band disguised as Josephine and Daphne, but further complications set in.
some-like-it-hot-1959-at-the-ritz.cast: Tony Curtis, Jack Lemmon, Marilyn Monroe, George Raft, Pat O'Brien, Joe E. Brown

bridesmaids-at-the-ritz.title: Bridesmaids
bridesmaids-at-the-ritz.overview: Annie's life is a mess. But when she finds out her lifetime best friend is engaged, she simply must serve as Lillian's maid of honor. Though lovelorn and broke, Annie bluffs her way through the expensive and bizarre rituals. With one chance to get it perfect, she’ll show Lillian and her bridesmaids just how far you’ll go for someone you love.
bridesmaids-at-the-ritz.cast: Kristen Wiig, Maya Rudolph, Rose Byrne, Chris O'Dowd, Melissa McCarthy, Wendi McLendon-Covey

the-fastest-bicycle-with-q-a-at-the-ritz.title: The Fastest Bicycle
the-fastest-bicycle-with-q-a-at-the-ritz.overview: The story of a London team’s mission to 'go fast' and their journey to the 'World Human Powered Speed Challenge' on Route 305, Battle Mountain, Nevada USA. There they discover an international community of speed freaks like no other. The Fastest Bicycle is a story of perseverance, as the team tackle a missing bike, high speed crashes, members departures, serious design flaws and injury. It’s also an exploration of community, as they discover that their competitors can also be their greatest allies.
the-fastest-bicycle-with-q-a-at-the-ritz.cast: Mike Burrows, Chris Boardman, Francois Pervis, Karen Darke, Ilona Pelletier, Todd Reichert

the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.title: The Odyssey
the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
the-overtones-up-close-and-personal.cast: Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Himesh Patel, Charlize Theron

trick-or-treat-family-silent-disco.overview: Greg Kielty's life is turned upside down when his estranged brother Dan turns up, claiming to have drunkenly run someone over. But has Dan just murdered a gangster's son? Or maybe there's an even more sinister explanation.
trick-or-treat-family-silent-disco.cast: Kris Marshall, Jason Flemyng, Maimie McCoy, Frances Barber, Hugo Speer, Jamie Sives

blazing-saddles-1974-at-the-ritz.title: Blazing Saddles
blazing-saddles-1974-at-the-ritz.overview: A town—where everyone seems to be named Johnson—stands in the way of the railroad. In order to grab their land, robber baron Hedley Lamarr sends his henchmen to make life in the town unbearable. After the sheriff is killed, the town demands a new sheriff from the Governor, so Hedley convinces him to send the town the first black sheriff in the west.
blazing-saddles-1974-at-the-ritz.cast: Cleavon Little, Gene Wilder, Slim Pickens, Harvey Korman, Madeline Kahn, Mel Brooks

the-witch-who-couldn-t-sleep.cast: Millie Perkins, Lonny Chapman, Vanessa Brown, Peggy Feury, Jean Pierre Camps, Mark Livingston

guilty-pleasures-at-the-ritz.title: Guilty Pleasures

On the first floor lives Silvia Resino (Alexandra Paulhiac), who has three psychotic admirers while on the second floor, RoseMarie Curtis (Sasha Graham) is descending into madness after joining an insane acting school.
guilty-pleasures-at-the-ritz.cast: Sasha Graham, Alexandra Paulhiac, Eraldo Maglara, Joe Zaso, Liz Haverty, Joseph Marzano

seann-walsh-this-is-torture.title: Seann Walsh: Kiss
seann-walsh-this-is-torture.overview: In this hilarious and critically acclaimed stand-up show, Seann Walsh recounts living through the centre of a media storm in his distinctively shambolic, intense and energetic trademark style.  Recorded live at the Bill Murray pub in Angel, London.

an-evening-of-burlesque-cabaret-at-the-r.cast: Christian Zilko, Nate Rediers, Conor Copley, Jaquevis Harmon, Thomas Avona, Josh Gorman

mark-smith-antiques-expert-on-the-road.title: Mark Smith: Old Smudge
mark-smith-antiques-expert-on-the-road.overview: Mark Smith (Russell Howard's Good News) returns to Edinburgh with a new show and Lord have mercy is he excited. Expect to hear him cram as many funny, stupid and potentially dangerous observations into the show as possible on topics as diverse as bowling, going bowling, and do you like bowling? There's also a couple of dick jokes. In a nutshell then, something for everyone.

falmouth-soul-sensation-at-the-ritz.title: Off The Radar, On The Stage: Music in Falmouth
falmouth-soul-sensation-at-the-ritz.overview: An exploration of Falmouth’s vibrant DIY music scene, capturing the community spirit, resilience, and creativity that keep grassroots music alive in a small university town far away from big cities.
